## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `tests\Validate.ps1` passes.
- [ ] No third-party binaries or machine-specific profiles/IDs are included.
- [ ] Display changes were tested in both directions, if applicable.
- [ ] Audio restoration was tested with the pre-entry default, if applicable.
- [ ] Steam crash/Big Picture unexpected-close behavior was tested, if applicable.
- [ ] README or changelog was updated.
